Lean.instantiateMVars.code: Lean.instantiateMVars {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadMCtx m] (e : Expr) : m Expr
Lean.instantiateMVars.fullDefinition: def instantiateMVars [Monad m] [MonadMCtx m] (e : Expr) : m Expr := do   if !e.hasMVar then     return e   else     let (r, mctx) := instantiateMVarsCore (← getMCtx) e     modifyMCtx fun _ => mctx     return r
Lean.instantiateMVars.description: A function that replaces mutable variables in an expression with their current values within a computational monad context.

Lean.MVarId.assign.code: Lean.MVarId.assign {m : Type → Type} [MonadMCtx m] (mvarId : MVarId) (val : Expr) : m Unit
Lean.MVarId.assign.comment:
Add `mvarId := x` to the metavariable assignment.
This method does not check whether `mvarId` is already assigned, nor it checks whether
a cycle is being introduced, or whether the expression has the right type.
This is a low-level API, and it is safer to use `isDefEq (mkMVar mvarId) x`.
Lean.MVarId.assign.fullDefinition: def _root_.Lean.MVarId.assign [MonadMCtx m] (mvarId : MVarId) (val : Expr) : m Unit :=   modifyMCtx fun m => { m with eAssignment := m.eAssignment.insert mvarId val }
Lean.MVarId.assign.description: A method that assigns a value to a specified mutable variable without performing any checks for pre-existing assignments or type correctness.
